tasks.label: fallout1-c64: run vaultexit in VICE
tasks.detail: Builds the current vault-exit scene and launches it interactively in x64sc — a real window, real keyboard, not the headless harness used for automated checks. Runs ports/fallout1-c64/target/run-vice.sh as a real script file rather than an inline shell one-liner — an earlier version embedded the whole command (including a $'...'-quoted -keybuf string) directly in this JSON's args, and on a real machine that extra layer of quoting corrupted the auto-typed LOAD command. A script file has one unambiguous layer of shell parsing.

tasks.label: fallout1-c64: run vaultexit in VICE (no auto-load)
tasks.detail: Same as above but drops the auto-typed LOAD/RUN — use if you want to type the load command yourself, or explore the emulator's own UI first.
